mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations, increasing equity prices.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.5% signals a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 265) signals an impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 265, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion marked by high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 6.0), the S&P 500 is expected to underperform due to overvaluation and rising interest rate expectations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1500 and UNRATE < 6.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500) combined with low industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a demand-supply imbalance that reduces corporate profit visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO < 100, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 140000) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 140000, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1 < 19000) signals an impending recession that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 19000, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
